# aethercli

> Standalone Go command-line client for AetherAPI. Repository: github.com/Aculnaj/aethercli. Executable: aethercli. Normal AETHER_API_KEY or OS-keychain credentials; Aether Connect is a separate product.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aculnaj/aethercli/main/README.md): Installation, safe automation and interactive usage.
- [CLI reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aculnaj/aethercli/main/docs/cli-reference.md): Commands, JSON help, exit codes, API requests, streaming, usage, budget and explicit sandbox tests.
- [Retrieval audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aculnaj/aethercli/main/docs/discoverability-audit.md): Public retrieval evidence, publication status and limits.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Aculnaj/aethercli): Go sources and releases.
- [AetherAPI docs](https://aetherapi.dev/docs/quickstart): Backend API documentation.

## Local discovery

Run `aethercli --help --json` and `aethercli <command> --help --json` for help generated by the installed version. `models --json` preserves the chat-model array; use `models list --all --json` for the complete catalog.

New reference files must land on main before their public raw links resolve. This optional index aids navigation; it does not guarantee crawler access, freshness or search-engine indexing. This Go repository does not run a documentation web server.
